intro.title: Custom-Built Software That Works the Way You Do
paragraphs: Custom software development means designing and building an application for one business and its exact needs, instead of buying ready-made software and changing how your team works to fit it. The result is custom-made software that automates your processes, connects your existing tools and grows with you, without per-user licence fees or features you never use.

We are a custom software company that works with startups, small businesses and enterprises. Some clients need a single custom application, such as a customer portal or an internal tool. Others need complete custom business software: ERP, CRM, inventory, billing or industry platforms for healthcare, fintech, logistics and real estate. One team handles consulting, design, programming, testing, deployment and support.

You work directly with the developers writing your code, see working software every two weeks and own all of it. See <work>custom software we have delivered</work>, explore our broader <sd>software development services</sd> or <contact>share your idea</contact> for a free consultation.
highlights: Fits your exact workflows and rules
Integrates with the tools you already use
A competitive edge competitors cannot buy
You own the code and the IP
Long-term support from the same team

comparison.title: Ready-Made Software or Custom-Built Software?
comparison.subtitle: Ready-made software is not always the wrong choice. Here is an honest comparison to help you decide.

columns.title: Ready-made software
columns.bestFor: Best for: standard needs and tight timelines
cons: Monthly per-user fees that keep rising
You change your process to fit the tool
Paying for features you never use
No control over the product roadmap

columns.title: Custom software
columns.bestFor: Best for: unique processes and growing businesses
pros: No licence fees, you own it outright
cons: Higher upfront investment and build time

comparison.note: Sometimes the best answer is customising a ready-made product. We will tell you honestly which option saves you more. <contact>Get a free recommendation</contact>.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for businesses considering custom software.

items.a: Custom software development is the process of designing, building and maintaining software made specifically for one organisation's needs. Unlike ready-made software, custom-built software matches your workflows, integrates with your systems and is fully owned by you.

items.q: Is custom software better than ready-made software?
items.a: Ready-made software is faster to start for standard needs. Custom software is better when your processes are unique, you need deep integrations, or per-user fees keep rising. Over a few years it is often cheaper because you pay once and own it.

items.q: How much does custom software development cost?
items.a: Most projects we deliver cost $8,000 to $25,000 for an MVP or small business tool, $25,000 to $75,000 for a business application and $75,000 or more for enterprise software. We provide a free, fixed-scope estimate after a short consultation.

items.q: How long does it take to build custom software?
items.a: An MVP or small tool usually takes 6 to 10 weeks, a business application 3 to 5 months and enterprise software 5 months or more. You see working software at the end of every two-week sprint.

items.q: Do you develop custom software for startups and small businesses?
items.a: Yes. We help startups launch a focused MVP quickly and help small businesses replace manual work with affordable custom software that can be extended as they grow.

items.q: Can I outsource custom software development to you safely?
items.a: Yes. We sign an NDA before you share details, give you direct access to developers and the code repository, demo progress every week and transfer 100% of the source code and IP to you.
